Spotify and Nokia forecast profits above estimates

Spotify projected fourth-quarter profits exceeding estimates, attributing the forecast to advancements in Artificial Intelligence. Similarly, Nokia reported its third-quarter profits surpassed expectations, driven by demand for AI data center equipment.
